sources.title: LowFormer: Hardware Efficient Design for Convolutional Transformer ...
sources.snippet: We combine both macro and micro design to create a new family of hardware-efficient backbone networks called LowFormer. LowFormer achieves a remarkable speedup in terms of throughput and latency, while achieving similar or better accuracy than current state-of-the-art efficient backbones.
